The hydraulic tilt-deck trailer shall be sized and rated for safe transportation of the offered crane and the associated accessories.
The trailer shall include all necessary tie-down points, ramps or hydraulic loading components, and track mats identified in the pricing schedule.

The contractor shall provide replacement/repair parts availability, technical-support contact information, maintenance/service support, operating and maintenance manuals, safety documentation, illustrated parts information, and the two-year spare-parts and maintenance-support package identified in the pricing schedule.
